title: More detailed image-based communications with emotion (rockets, troop movements)

tellings.quote: >> Very like pictures, images. Yeah, these communications they were they were much more uh colorful.

plain: Between 1990 and 1993, at a site he calls Base 2, messages he says came from non-human beings started reaching him as vivid pictures carrying emotion, showing things like rockets and troop movements. A former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says the NSA hired him to take in these messages, tells Michels this from his own experience. He says the later communications were "very like pictures, images" and "much more colorful" than the ones before, which, if true, would mean the contact was becoming richer over time.
